zh: 每科真正需要补的题数是max(0, needed−answered)，与其他科目无关；想让通过的科目尽量多，就应该先挑缺口小的科目。
把所有缺口升序排序，从最小的开始依次支付，直到剩下的q不够支付下一个缺口为止，已经支付的科目数就是答案。
计算每科缺口max(0,needed[i]−answered[i])并升序排序；依次遍历：若缺口大于q就停止，否则q减去缺口、答案加1。已经达标的科目缺口为0，会被自然计入。
en: A subject really needs max(0, needed - answered) more answers, independent of the other subjects; to pass as many subjects as possible, prefer the ones with the smallest gap.
Sort all gaps ascending and pay for them from the smallest, until what is left of q cannot cover the next gap; the number of subjects paid for is the answer.

Compute each gap max(0, needed[i] - answered[i]) and sort ascending; go through them: stop when a gap exceeds q, otherwise subtract it from q and count one more subject. Subjects already passing have gap 0 and are counted automatically.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Compute each subject's non-negative shortfall, sort them in ascending order, and pay for the cheapest subjects first.

## Proof of correctness

Any choice of t subjects needs at least the sum of the t smallest shortfalls, and choosing those subjects meets this lower bound exactly. Adding subjects one by one until the next would exceed q gives the maximum number of subjects that can pass; subjects with zero shortfall are counted automatically.

## Complexity

Time O(n log n), space O(n).
